1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Black-box coverage for the exact release-PR action executable. The fake
     3	# process boundary proves the script executes only Callisto's closed decision
     4	# set and only the forge commit API (never `git push`); Rust tests cover
     5	# decision policy itself.
     6	#
     7	# This stubs `callisto` with hand-written JSON fixtures, so it cannot catch a
     8	# mismatch between what the real binary serializes and what this script's jq
     9	# expressions expect -- see test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh, which
    10	# calls the compiled binary, for that check.
    11	set -euo pipefail
    12	
    13	action_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    14	script="$action_dir/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh"
    15	
    16	run_case() {
    17	  local prs="$1" decision="$2" label_exists="${3:-true}"
    18	  local calls_file output_file harness verify_count_file
    19	  calls_file="$(mktemp)"
    20	  output_file="$(mktemp)"
    21	  verify_count_file="$(mktemp)"
    22	  harness="$(mktemp)"
    23	  rm -f "$verify_count_file"
    24	
    25	  {
    26	    cat <<'STUBS'
    27	callisto() {
    28	  echo "callisto $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
    29	  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr decide '* ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$DECISION"; return 0; fi
    30	  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr verify '* ]]; then
    31	    local n arg previous='' applied_head='' snapshot=''
    32	    n=$(( $(cat "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
    33	    echo "$n" > "$VERIFY_COUNT_FILE"
    34	    if [[ "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" != 0 && "$n" == "$VERIFY_FAIL_AT" ]]; then return 1; fi
    35	    if [[ "$REQUIRE_APPLIED_HEAD" == true && "$n" == 3 ]]; then
    36	      for arg in "$@"; do
    37	        case "$previous" in
    38	          --applied-head) applied_head="$arg" ;;
    39	          --snapshot) snapshot="$arg" ;;
    40	        esac
    41	        previous="$arg"
    42	      done
    43	      if [[ "$applied_head" != "$NEW_SHA" ]]; then
    44	        echo 'verification rejected missing or wrong applied head' >> "$CALLS_FILE"
    45	        return 1
    46	      fi
    47	      jq -e --argjson number "$(jq -r '.action.pullRequestNumber' <<< "$DECISION")" --arg head "$NEW_SHA" \
    48	        'any(.openPullRequests[]; .number == $number and .headCommit == $head)' <<< "$snapshot" >/dev/null \
    49	        || return 1
    50	      echo 'verification accepted the applied head observed on the moved PR' >> "$CALLS_FILE"
    51	    fi
    52	    return 0
    53	  fi
    54	  if [[ " $* " == *' release-pr commit-plan '* ]]; then
    55	    local out='' prev=''
    56	    for a in "$@"; do
    57	      [[ "$prev" == '--out' ]] && out="$a"
    58	      prev="$a"
    59	    done
    60	    printf '%s\n' "$COMMIT_PLAN" > "$out"
    61	    return "$COMMIT_PLAN_CODE"
    62	  fi
    63	  case "$1" in
    64	    matrix) printf '%s\n' '{"platformTargets":[]}' ;;
    65	    compose-pr-body) echo 'composed release body' ;;
    66	    version) return 0 ;;
    67	    *) echo "unexpected callisto invocation: $*" >&2; return 97 ;;
    68	  esac
    69	}
    70	gh() {
    71	  echo "gh $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
    72	  local joined=" $* "
    73	  case "$1 $2" in
    74	    'pr list') printf '%s\n' "$PR_LIST"; return 0 ;;
    75	    'pr view') echo 'existing body'; return 0 ;;
    76	    'pr create') echo "$PR_CREATE_URL"; return 0 ;;
    77	    'pr edit') return 0 ;;
    78	    'label list') echo "$LABEL_EXISTS"; return 0 ;;
    79	    'label create') return 0 ;;
    80	  esac
    81	  if [[ "$1" == 'api' ]]; then
    82	    if [[ "$joined" == *' graphql '* ]]; then
    83	      [[ "$GRAPHQL_CODE" == 0 ]] || return "$GRAPHQL_CODE"
    84	      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
    85	      return 0
    86	    fi
    87	    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/commits/'* ]]; then
    88	      printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TREE"
    89	      return 0
    90	    fi
    91	    # The bare collection endpoint (`.../git/refs`, no ref name in the URL
    92	    # path -- the branch only appears in the `-f ref=refs/heads/...` value)
    93	    # is used for ref *creation*: the staging-ref POST fallback and the
    94	    # create-decision's initial attempt to create the real branch.
    95	    if [[ "$joined" == *' -X POST '* && "$joined" == *'/git/refs '* ]]; then
    96	      [[ "$joined" == *'ref=refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]] && return 0
    97	      return "$MOVE_POST_CODE"
    98	    fi
    99	    # `.../git/refs/heads/<branch>` (the branch name in the URL path itself)
   100	    # is used for PATCH (force-update an existing ref), GET (confirm), and
   101	    # DELETE (staging cleanup).
   102	    if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'* ]]; then
   103	      if [[ "$joined" == *'/git/refs/heads/'*'--staging'* ]]; then
   104	        [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]] && return "$STAGING_PATCH_CODE"
   105	        return 0
   106	      fi
   107	      if [[ "$joined" == *' -X PATCH '* ]]; then
   108	        [[ "$MOVE_PATCH_CODE" == 0 ]] || return "$MOVE_PATCH_CODE"
   109	        if [[ "$REQUIRE_APPLIED_HEAD" == true ]]; then
   110	          PR_LIST=$(jq --argjson number "$(jq -r '.action.pullRequestNumber' <<< "$DECISION")" --arg head "$NEW_SHA" \
   111	            'map(if .number == $number then .headRefOid = $head else . end)' <<< "$PR_LIST")
   112	        fi
   113	        return 0
   114	      fi
   115	      printf '%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
   116	      return 0
   117	    fi
   118	  fi
   119	  return 0
   120	}
   121	git() {
   122	  echo "git $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
   123	  case "$1" in
   124	    rev-parse) echo "$BASE_SHA"; return 0 ;;
   125	    add) return 0 ;;
   126	    status) echo ' M Cargo.toml'; return 0 ;;
   127	    write-tree) echo "$LOCAL_TREE"; return 0 ;;
   128	  esac
   129	  return 0
   130	}
   131	STUBS
   132	  } > "$harness"
   133	
   134	  set +e
   135	  CALLS_FILE="$calls_file" PR_LIST="$prs" DECISION="$decision" LABEL_EXISTS="$label_exists" \
   136	    VERIFY_FAIL_AT="${VERIFY_FAIL_AT:-0}" VERIFY_COUNT_FILE="$verify_count_file" \
   137	    REQUIRE_APPLIED_HEAD="${REQUIRE_APPLIED_HEAD:-false}" \
   138	    STAGING_PATCH_CODE="${STAGING_PATCH_CODE:-0}" GRAPHQL_CODE="${GRAPHQL_CODE:-0}" \
   139	    MOVE_PATCH_CODE="${MOVE_PATCH_CODE:-0}" MOVE_POST_CODE="${MOVE_POST_CODE:-0}" \
   140	    COMMIT_PLAN_CODE="${COMMIT_PLAN_CODE:-0}" COMMIT_PLAN="${COMMIT_PLAN:-$default_commit_plan}" \
   141	    NEW_SHA="${NEW_SHA:-$default_new_sha}" LOCAL_TREE="${LOCAL_TREE:-tree-aaaa}" REMOTE_TREE="${REMOTE_TREE:-tree-aaaa}" \
   142	    PR_CREATE_URL="${PR_CREATE_URL:-https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/pull/99}" \
   143	    BASE_SHA='0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567' GITHUB_OUTPUT="$output_file" \
   144	    INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND='callisto version' \
   145	    INPUT_DECISION_PATH='.callisto/release-decision.json' \
   146	    INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE='chore(release): version packages' \
   147	    INPUT_TITLE='chore(release): version packages' \
   148	    INPUT_PR_LABEL='callisto: release' \
   149	    INPUT_SETUP_GIT_USER=true \
   150	    INPUT_BRANCH=main \
   151	    INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH='callisto/version-packages' \
   152	    INPUT_CWD=. \
   153	    GITHUB_REPOSITORY='orin-dx/callisto' \
   154	    bash -c 'source "$1"; source "$2"' -- "$harness" "$script" > /dev/null 2>&1
   155	  local code=$?
   156	  set -e
   157	
   158	  printf '%s\n---calls---\n' "$code"
   159	  cat "$calls_file"
   160	  printf '%s\n' '---outputs---'
   161	  cat "$output_file"
   162	  rm -f "$calls_file" "$output_file" "$harness" "$verify_count_file"
   163	}
   164	
   165	default_new_sha='deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef'
   166	default_commit_plan='{"schemaVersion":1,"baseCommit":"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567","message":"chore(release): version packages","additions":[{"path":"VERSION","contentsBase64":"MS4yLjM="}],"deletions":[],"totalContentBytes":5}'
   167	
   168	create='{"schemaVersion":2,"action":{"kind":"create","branch":"callisto/version-packages","stagingBranch":"callisto/version-packages--staging"}}'
   169	update='{"schemaVersion":2,"action":{"kind":"update","pullRequestNumber":42,"branch":"callisto/version-packages","expectedHeadCommit":"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567","stagingBranch":"callisto/version-packages--staging"}}'
   170	fallback_branch='callisto/REDACTED'
   171	retained="{\"schemaVersion\":2,\"action\":{\"kind\":\"update\",\"pullRequestNumber\":99,\"branch\":\"$fallback_branch\",\"expectedHeadCommit\":\"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567\",\"stagingBranch\":\"callisto/version-packages--staging\"}}"
   172	noop='{"schemaVersion":2,"action":{"kind":"noop","reason":{"kind":"noPendingChangesets"}}}'
   173	
   174	fail=0
